messages.subject: Distance 7 Release
parts:
Hello distance samplers,

We are proud to announce the release of Distance 7.0!

Distance 7 has progressed through the alpha and beta testing stages and we are now pleased to recommend it as the current version of Distance.

Distance 7 brings you a range of new features:
  • Simulation Engine - try your surveys out on a computer before you spend lots of money in the field!
  • Multi-Analysis Engine - deals with unidentified sightings, model uncertainty and covariate uncertainty
  • Analytic variance for density surface modelling - we now provide an analytic method for variance calculation.
  • New R libraries - Distance 7 contains the latest R libraries (mrds, dsm, mads and DSsim)
We are continuing active development of Distance 7 -- please get in touch if you have ideas about what you would like to see in the next version of Distance.

Best wishes,

The Distance Development Team
